name: Jellyfin Federation
description: Aggregate content from multiple Jellyfin servers into unified virtual libraries
overview: The Jellyfin Federation Plugin allows you to create a unified media library by aggregating content from multiple remote Jellyfin servers. Stream content from any server without file synchronization.
changelog: Security and reliability. Discovery requires an explicit admin request and sharing choice; friend and pool callbacks are authenticated, and pending requests, pools, user rules, party snapshots, availability blobs and urgent sync notices are bounded. Session registration and streaming work again, zero-share friends cannot enumerate users, and administrator reporting is corrected. Upgrade both servers for authenticated friend accept/reject callbacks. Includes everything in 0.0.204.
